value.rationale: An infinite natural graph family has an already-known nonequivariant homotopy type, but full integer action distinguishes it from arbitrary wedges: degree-three exterior-cube augmentation module, degree-four triple-permutation lattice, and negative involution in both degrees. This fills a motivated symmetry gap and is not a restatement of dimension or finite table.
